facts.statement: OBS Studio's Auto-Configuration Wizard considers the user's recording or streaming goal, hardware, and network conditions when suggesting settings.

localized_statement.zh-CN: OBS Studio 的自动配置向导会考虑录制或直播目标、电脑硬件，以及直播时的网络状况来建议设置。

facts.source_quote: your computer's hardware resources, and your network conditions
facts.availability_note: The guide does not guarantee lag-free recording or a particular quality on every computer.

facts.statement: OBS recommends running a short test recording or stream before the real session to check settings.

localized_statement.zh-CN: OBS 建议在正式录制或直播前先做几分钟测试，检查设置是否合适。

facts.source_quote: strongly encourage running a test for a few minutes
facts.availability_note: A test is recommended because actual performance varies with equipment and settings.

facts.statement: OBS scenes can contain sources such as windows, webcams, images, and text.

localized_statement.zh-CN: OBS 场景可以组合窗口、摄像头、图片和文字等来源。

facts.source_quote: add whatever you want to capture ... window ... image, text or your entire display
facts.availability_note: Source availability can vary by operating system.

facts.statement: In Studio Mode, OBS shows the live scene and a separate edit scene; the user can transition the edited scene to live output.

localized_statement.zh-CN: OBS 工作室模式把直播画面和待编辑画面分开，用户可以编辑后再切换到直播输出。

facts.source_quote: current Live Scene ... on the right while your edit Scene on the left
facts.availability_note: This workflow does not guarantee error-free production.

facts.statement: OBS Studio's Virtual Camera can send an OBS scene to applications that accept a webcam input.

localized_statement.zh-CN: OBS Studio 的虚拟摄像头可把场景输出到接受摄像头输入的应用。

facts.source_quote: share your OBS Studio scene with any applications that can make use of a webcam
facts.availability_note: Compatibility depends on whether the receiving application can use a webcam.

facts.statement: The OBS Virtual Camera can be started from the Controls dock using Start Virtual Camera.

localized_statement.zh-CN: 可以在 OBS 的控制区点击“启动虚拟摄像头”来开启该功能。

facts.source_quote: click Start Virtual Camera in the Controls dock
facts.availability_note: Interface labels can vary by locale and version.

facts.statement: OBS has a Remux Recordings workflow for converting a recording into MP4 for editing or uploading.

localized_statement.zh-CN: OBS 提供“重新封装录制文件”流程，可把录制文件转成 MP4，方便后续剪辑或上传。

facts.source_quote: If you record in a file format that is not mp4 ... OBS has that built in for you
facts.availability_note: Remuxing is a local file conversion; the guide does not describe automatic social publishing.
